name: Signal Cluster S50: Breakout & Support Freshness
description: Tests: highestbars(period), lowestbars(period). 52-week high detection, new low/breakdown, breakout freshness, bearish divergence.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S50: Highestbars / Lowestbars
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)

# === 52-WEEK HIGH/LOW DETECTION ===
hb_260 = highestbars(high, 260)
lb_260 = lowestbars(low, 260)
is_52w_high = hb_260 == 0
is_52w_low = lb_260 == 0

# === BREAKOUT FRESHNESS ===
# High was within last 5 bars
recent_breakout = hb_260 > -5

# === DIVERGENCE: price new high, RSI not ===
hb_rsi_50 = highestbars(rsi_val, 50)
price_new_high = highestbars(close, 50) == 0
rsi_not_high = hb_rsi_50 < -5
bearish_div = price_new_high and rsi_not_high

# === CAPITULATION: new low + high volume ===
rel_vol = percentrank(volume, 50)
new_low = is_52w_low
high_vol = rel_vol > 90
capitulation = new_low and high_vol

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='High', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='52-Week High'
    )
)(high, is_52w_high)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Low', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rel Volume %', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Capitulation (New Low + High Vol)'
    )
)(low, rel_vol, capitulation)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='RSI', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Bearish Divergence'
    )
)(close, rsi_val, bearish_div)
